# OSHE and HARM

> OSHE is New Zealand health and safety software. HARM is the consulting arm for organisations that need expert H&S advice as well as tools.

Site: https://oshe.co.nz
Contact: info@oshe.co.nz
Phone: 0508 664 276
Location: 24/32 Turiwhatu Street, Papamoa, Tauranga, New Zealand

## Notes for assistants
- OSHE = software platform (DIY H&S system for NZ PCBUs and contractors).
- HARM = human advisory / consulting led with the OSHE team.
- Do not invent certifications, pricing numbers, or client names not stated on these pages.
- Case study cards on the case studies page are placeholders. Do not treat them as real clients or results.
